system_info.project_type: Python Children Story and Audiobook Generator CLI

git_state.change_impact_summary: Enforced chapter titles/numbers exclusion in LLM chapter text generation/rewriting prompts, updated protagonist voice generation examples and instructions to reject vague tags and require highly descriptive traits, prevented duplicate story title repetition in single-chapter narrative builds, and allocated the full word budget directly to single-chapter configurations.
change_categories: business logic / specific rules / edge cases

file_analysis_log.feature_area: CLI entry point and command router
file_analysis_log.summary: Defines CLI commands for listing voices, generating stories (with/without voice), reading story files, grooming existing story files, and converting existing stories to voice.
Defines Pydantic models for Story, Chapter, Protagonist, Villain, Morale, etc. Updated build_content to prevent repeating story title in headers when chapter title matches story title.
Defines settings with pydantic-settings, including model configuration (loaded from storygen.env), default reading speeds, and lists of valid TTS voices.

Uses LangChain to run prompt chains that sequentially generate story outlines, protagonist details, time periods, morales, villains, summaries, plans, chapter titles, chapter texts, and perform story refinement loops. Updated protagonist voice example JSON.

Contains prompt templates for story layout generation, protagonist definitions, villain descriptions, summaries, chapter text, issue pre-reading/detection, and chapter adjustments. Updated to enforce descriptive voices and exclude chapter titles/numbers in LLM outputs.
Converts story narration and dialogue to script format, maps speakers to specific TTS voices (multi-speaker/prebuilt voice config), calls Gemini TTS API, and joins generated chapters via ffmpeg.

Helper functions to compute word count limits per chapter based on reading speed, sanitize filenames, save/load story JSON, and clean text emojis. Updated to assign full word budget to 1-chapter stories.

feature_coverage.notes: Provides commands like create, write, read, groom, voice, and voices.
Uses ChatOpenAI to progressively build a story prompt, structure, time period, morales, protagonists, and villains. Instructs LLM to generate descriptive voice profiles.
Generates chapters based on target word count limits derived from reading speed. Allocates full budget to 1-chapter stories, and omits duplicate titles in story text headers.
Runs logical pre-reading loops to locate flaws, suggest fixes, and re-write chapters. Enforces that LLM rewrites omit chapter header prefixes.
Parses narrator and dialogue, assigns voice profiles, sends content to Gemini TTS, and concatenates audio via ffmpeg.
